answer: Bonds, not badges, buy a voice here. Every claim must sit atop escrow that slashes automatically when peers catch it false. A basalt-sealed deed costs the same whether you are one honest operator or a thousand masks, yet each mask must post its own. A botmaster can forge wallets like trinkets for a wharf market stall, but forging the collateral behind each one drains real treasury per head, so mass identities become ruin rather than leverage. Cloning is cheap; re-funding every slashed relic of a vanished fleet never is.
